submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input1 current SOUTHWEST run key is scale, camera, identity, full long-staff and framing master. Input2 authoritative character portrait. Input3 SW idle exact anatomy/camera/equipment. Input4 primary approved Taoist chibi painting style. Draw ONE independently articulated next sprite, transparent RGBA exactly SQUARE1254x1254 native>=1024. Same fixed SOUTHWEST three-quarter front-left camera, diagonally running toward lower-left/viewer, both amber eyes visible. ANATOMICAL RIGHT leg is initially screen-left leading, anatomical LEFT is initially screen-right trailing; legs may overlap during passing but never swap identity. Preserve head size andbody dimensions fromInput1; fixed central root/camera and ground. Keep all tips inside canvas. RIGHT hand always grips full long brown staff with sculpted gold ring and pointed lower finial; SAME staff length and grip location every frame, don't shorten to baton. LEFT forearm keeps jade-gold round shield, never detach/switch hands. Shoulder/elbow must swing opposite corresponding leg even while carrying equipment. Shield may coverforearm but connected leftshoulder/elbowremainplausible. Preserve brownpony/jaderibbons, goldforeheadmark, woodbeads, goldjadecoat, ivorypants,browngoldboots. Full body without cropping, shadow/floor/particles/weapontrails/glow/text/grid. Real transparent background and small jade ring hole, physical gold ringstructure. Not a sheet, mirrored pose, copiedframe, warp or interpolation. Each frame new anatomy pose. Controlled head/hip vertical bob fromstride only, no globalcanvas recenter/zoom.
Frame04/16: RIGHT support heel lifts in late stance, pushing body forward; LEFT knee drives past supporting right leg toward travel lower-left. RIGHT staff arm begins swinging forward and LEFT shield-arm backward, distinct shoulder and elbow motion.
